caption: Three ways the rotation of a portrait screen showing "Taps: 7" can end. The 7 survives only through the Bundle or the configChanges declaration; with no saving code the rebuilt activity starts at count = 0 and the label reads "Taps: 0".

spec.title: Rotation with count = 7
spec.aria: A portrait activity holding count = 7 with label Taps: 7 splits into three rotation outcomes: with no saving code a new activity has count 0 and shows Taps: 0; with a Bundle the new activity reads count 7 and shows Taps: 7; with configChanges the same activity keeps count 7 and shows Taps: 7.
